name: Answer mixed questions on diverse topics
description: Users asked for information, definitions, or creative content across a wide range of unrelated topics, frequently combining multiple distinct subjects within a single query. The requests covered diverse fields such as health, science, history, literature, and practical skills, often varying in specific requirements like providing mnemonics, summaries, or step-by-step instructions.
